entries.description: djaun doeniya mê hai
entries.subject: djaun doeniya

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki, ego apan ke iddjat aur ekahie aur ego basis hak ba, sab sansaar ke basis, aadjádi, niaai aur shaant hai, djaun doeniya mê hai.

entries.description: ke mann mê òtna ghoesa lail hai
entries.subject: ke mann

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki djaun nietchai aur thokaráe hoige hai aadmi ke hak ke, ohi bhi katthor-behwaar pais hai, djaun doeniya bhar ke insaan sab insaan ke mann (bhi) mê òtna ghoesa lail hai, aur ego doeniya aaige hai djaun mê ek aaadmi ke bole ke aur sòche ke aadjádi chaahín, aur dèrai aur djaran mê koi ke na chaahin rehke, ohi rakam ke doeniya, sab aam manai ke khatien, sab se barka samaan hai.

entries.description: hai djaun mê ek aaadmi ke bole ke aur sòche ke aadjádi chaahín
entries.subject: hai djaun
entries.object: ek aaadmi ke bole ke aur sòche ke aadjádi chaahín

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki djaun nietchai aur thokaráe hoige hai aadmi ke hak ke, ohi bhi katthor-behwaar pais hai, djaun doeniya bhar ke insaan sab insaan ke mann (bhi) mê òtna ghoesa lail hai, aur ego doeniya aaige hai djaun mê ek aaadmi ke bole ke aur sòche ke aadjádi chaahín, aur dèrai aur djaran mê koi ke na chaahin rehke, ohi rakam ke doeniya, sab aam manai ke khatien, sab se barka samaan hai.

Bichaar kar ke, ki djaun dès ‘Verenigde Naties’ ke djhoend hai, ohi djabaan dees hai, ki oe sab, ‘Verenigde Naties’ ke saathe, kausis kari, ohoe djaun doeniya mê iddjat sab aadmi ke hak ke chaahín howe ke, aur aadjádi djaun djaroerat hai, barháwe ke.

entries.description: aur djaran mê koi ke na chaahin rehke
entries.subject: aur djaran

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki basis hai, dès ke bietch mê soemmat rehke chaahin aur sab dès aapan-aapan sanghat se rehe aur karobaar ke mel-djol ke karen.

entries.description: okrèn Chitti mê bole hai
entries.subject: okrèn Chitti

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki ‘Verenigde Naties’ ke djanne, okrèn Chitti mê bole hai, ki oke biswaas hai, ohi hak mê, djaun insaan ki djindagi ke khatien djaroerat maane hai, ek aadmi ke iddjat aur kimmat mê aur mard aur meraroe ki barabar hak djaun hai, ohi (biswaas kar ke) bolies hai ki, samaadj ke barháwat, aur djindagi ki oepai aur barka aadjádi mê, aage kari.

spans.text: Bichaar kar ke, ki ‘Verenigde Naties’ ke djanne, okrèn Chitti mê bole hai, ki oke biswaas hai, ohi hak mê, djaun insaan ki djindagi ke khatien djaroerat maane hai, ek aadmi ke iddjat aur kimmat mê aur mard aur meraroe ki barabar hak djaun hai, ohi (biswaas kar ke) bolies hai ki, samaadj ke barháwat, aur djindagi ki oepai aur barka aadjádi mê, aage kari.

entries.description: ke roop mê pahichaan kar sakal djaai
entries.subject: ke roop

spans.text: Sab koi, djaune ka ni kahaan rehe hai, kanoen ke aage, ke hak hai, ek insaan ke roop mê pahichaan kar sakal djaai.

entries.description: dam saamiel mê hak hai
entries.subject: dam saamiel

spans.text: Sab koi, ek dam saamiel mê hak hai, ego satcha aur khoellam-khoella soenái paawe ke, ego djaadj ke aage se djaunne apan mann ke satchai se kaam kare hai.

entries.description: ke aankhie mê bekasoer hai
entries.subject: ke aankhie

spans.text: Sab koi, djaune ego kharaabie ke khatien pakraan hai, ohi sab, kanoen ke aankhie mê bekasoer hai, tab le okar kasurwaar kanoen se, aur niyaaidhis ke maaren, khoelá mê, saamiel waalan ke saathe, na bòl bhail.

entries.task_id: ke kanoen|mê|oisan goenaah na bolal-likhal raha
entries.description: ke kanoen mê oisan goenaah na bolal-likhal raha
entries.subject: ke kanoen

spans.text: Koi ke na paai kasoer ego goenaah ke, djaune oe karies hai ego tem pe, jab le dès aur doeniya ke kanoen mê oisan goenaah na bolal-likhal raha.
Auro ego aur barka sadjaa na dei karsakal djaai, ohi sadjaa se djaun ohoe tem pe, djab goenah karies raha, kanoen mê likhal raha.

entries.description: ke bietch mê aai
entries.subject: ke bietch

spans.text: Djab kouno ehi chiedjwan ke bietch mê aai, tab sab koi ke hak hai, kanoen ke oke rattcha par, ohi ‘bietch me kudaai’ se.

entries.subject: Verenigde Naties

spans.text: Bole hai ki, ehi Kahna djaun sab insaan ke hak ke khatien hai, (ohi) soemmat sè (bole hai ki) ego djaroerat ba, djaun sab log aur sab dès ke pahunche ke chaahín, kaahe ke sab aadmi aur sab toekarra ke samaadj, ehi Kahna, bègar chore ke, okrè man mê rakhe, aur samadj-boedj ke sikhai aur siettcha leke ehi hak aur aadjádi, ke iddjat aage kari aur barháwai ke karen leike, aapan dès mê aur doesar dès se, rattcha kari ekkrè pahíchaane aur samdjhawal djaun soemmat sè howe hoi, ehi djoend ke djannè mê bietch aur doesar djannè djaun rehe hai okrèn niyaai sè:
Oeh sab ke barabar hak hai, biyaa kare mê, biyaah ke djindagi mê aur batwaara mê.

folded.id: ke kanoen|mê|oisan goenaah na bolal-likhal raha
folded.subject: ke kanoen

spans.text: Koi ke na paai kasoer ego goenaah ke, djaune oe karies hai ego tem pe, jab le dès aur doeniya ke kanoen mê oisan goenaah na bolal-likhal raha.
Auro ego aur barka sadjaa na dei karsakal djaai, ohi sadjaa se djaun ohoe tem pe, djab goenah karies raha, kanoen mê likhal raha.

Bichaar kar ke, ki djaun nietchai aur thokaráe hoige hai aadmi ke hak ke, ohi bhi katthor-behwaar pais hai, djaun doeniya bhar ke insaan sab insaan ke mann (bhi) mê òtna ghoesa lail hai, aur ego doeniya aaige hai djaun mê ek aaadmi ke bole ke aur sòche ke aadjádi chaahín, aur dèrai aur djaran mê koi ke na chaahin rehke, ohi rakam ke doeniya, sab aam manai ke khatien, sab se barka samaan hai.
Sab koi, djaune ka ni kahaan rehe hai, kanoen ke aage, ke hak hai, ek insaan ke roop mê pahichaan kar sakal djaai.

Bole hai ki, ehi Kahna djaun sab insaan ke hak ke khatien hai, (ohi) soemmat sè (bole hai ki) ego djaroerat ba, djaun sab log aur sab dès ke pahunche ke chaahín, kaahe ke sab aadmi aur sab toekarra ke samaadj, ehi Kahna, bègar chore ke, okrè man mê rakhe, aur samadj-boedj ke sikhai aur siettcha leke ehi hak aur aadjádi, ke iddjat aage kari aur barháwai ke karen leike, aapan dès mê aur doesar dès se, rattcha kari ekkrè pahíchaane aur samdjhawal djaun soemmat sè howe hoi, ehi djoend ke djannè mê bietch aur doesar djannè djaun rehe hai okrèn niyaai sè:

Bichaar kar ke, ki ‘Verenigde Naties’ ke djanne, okrèn Chitti mê bole hai, ki oke biswaas hai, ohi hak mê, djaun insaan ki djindagi ke khatien djaroerat maane hai, ek aadmi ke iddjat aur kimmat mê aur mard aur meraroe ki barabar hak djaun hai, ohi (biswaas kar ke) bolies hai ki, samaadj ke barháwat, aur djindagi ki oepai aur barka aadjádi mê, aage kari.
Djab djaidaad hai kouno ke, tab na ho sake hai ki kouno doesarèn, bekaren se, okar djaaid chhien pai.
Ehi hak ke mautabik bhi hai ki doesar dharm lei kar sake hai, djable koi maange badalwaawe hai okar dharm aur sòch-bichaar ke, tab oke ohi hak aur aadjádi hai, kare ke.

folded.id: verenigde naties|ki|sòch se na patte hai
folded.subject: Verenigde Naties

spans.text: Djab koi kanoen dwaara se saatail hai, kouno goenaah ke djaun des ke maaren na raha, ki kouno karen ke djaune Verenigde Naties ki sòch se na patte hai, tab ehi hak, djaune oepra likhal hai, ohi na milli.
